transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
DeepSeek has open-sourced dsh-superagent, a router-worker coding agent that cuts task time by 1.9x in simulations, reported by MarkTechPost with an MIT license.
Google is testing a new Gemini 4 Carbon checkpoint on Arena that improves 3D and coding performance, still open per TestingCatalog AI News, with early tests showing stronger outputs.
Ed Elson, a markets podcaster, warns investors are misreading Anthropic's S-1, citing $150B artificial intelligence compute plans and $2B operating loss, still open per Business Insider.
China's DeepSeek has unveiled a multitasking Super Agent that operates without instructions and completes tasks autonomously, reported by 아시아경제.
NVIDIA is reportedly exploring Teflon, a non-stick cookware material, to reduce signal loss in artificial intelligence chips amid transmission bottlenecks in next-generation NVLink switch boards, still open per Wccftech.
Free every hour.
